title: AS2 compiler: int(x) and Number(x) should emit ActionToInteger/ActionToNumber not ActionCallFunction
description: In compiler.ts, int(x) and Number(x) fall through to generic ActionCallFunction (0x3D) which does a global function lookup at runtime. Flash Professional emits native AVM1 type-coercion opcodes instead: int(x) → ActionToInteger (0x18), Number(x) → ActionToNumber (0x30). Fix: in compileCallExpression, detect CallExpression with callee=Identifier('int') and emit: compile arg + ActionToInteger (0x18). Same for Number(x) → ActionToNumber (0x30). Note: Math.round(x) and Math.floor(x) are separate — only bare int() and Number() coercion calls are affected.
